description: Pierce County, Washington publishes this geospatial resource. Coverage is the county or the specific subarea named below. Linked point and polygon layers describe mobile-home parcels and mobile-home parks. The native layers expose point, polygon geometry and named attributes, including Real_ParcelNumber, MH_ParcelNumber, Year_Built, Serial_Number, MH_Length, MH_Width. It provides source-defined infrastructure geometry, constraints or measurements for hazard exposure studies. Park polygons omit individual homes, which are provided by the linked point layer. Building dimensions and year-built fields exist, but occupancy and structural performance are not established. The public county catalogue advertises ArcGIS REST access and export descriptors such as GeoJSON, CSV and shapefile. Public metadata access was verified; no feature query or file download was performed. Reuse is subject to county terms linked by the provider; the PDF terms were not read, so no open licence or unrestricted reuse is assumed. Charges are not stated. Metadata modification dates do not establish observation dates, and a regular update schedule is not stated. No directly related active record was confirmed for this resource.
